en: A black and white photograph showing a historic European town square with a prominent fountain in the foreground, adorned with statues. In the background, there is a notable building featuring a tall clock or bell tower with gothic-revival architecture and patterned brickwork. People are seen walking and bicycling. Surrounding the square are 19th-century building façades with visible shop signs.
